 Swiggy Ltd. (SWIGGY) traded at Rs 213.9 versus the previous close of Rs 222.45, a fall of 3.84%. The stock opened at Rs 221, reached a high of Rs 221, touched a low of Rs 213.15.
 Swiggy Ltd. was trading at Rs 213.9, down Rs 8.55 or 3.84% from the previous close of Rs 222.45. The session opened at Rs 221 and moved no higher than that opening level, before touching a low of Rs 213.15, which is also the new 52-week low. The latest traded price was near the bottom of the day’s range, which keeps the Swiggy Ltd. 52 Week Low Streak in focus.
 The move leaves the stock with a market capitalisation of Rs 63,155.97 crore. In the context of the Swiggy Ltd. 52 Week Low Streak , the price action shows that the repeated yearly low is being registered even without a fresh intraday rebound above the opening price. The current price remains only marginally above the day’s low, which reinforces that the latest session continued the same downward pattern seen through the streak. For readers following Swiggy Ltd. Share Price Today , this is best understood as a continuing breakdown rather than a one-off dip.
 What the Repeated 52-Week Lows Show 
 The Swiggy Ltd. 52 Week Low Streak is now four consecutive sessions long, and that is the most important fact in the sequence. Across the streak, the stock has declined 7.6%, which means the repeated lows are not just a daily headline but a cumulative move that has steadily pushed the price to a new one-year trough each session. The fresh low at Rs 213.15 marks the latest step in that extended pattern.
 If the market needed proof that the weakness has been persistent, the streak provides it. The previous trading day’s low was exceeded only on the downside again, and that repeated reset is what defines the Swiggy Ltd. 52 Week Low Streak . No company-specific trigger is established by the price sequence itself, so the clean interpretation is simple: the stock has kept printing lower one-year lows, and the market has not yet reversed that pattern. For investors tracking Swiggy Ltd. New One Year Low , the cumulative move matters as much as the latest print.
